tab.title: Tmux Configuration
tab.subtitle: Manage the tmux configuration of your hosts: per host, per folder, per tag or for every machine.
tab.noSelection: Select hosts to apply a configuration.

preview.title: Configuration preview
preview.snippetHeading: User snippet (sourced after the generated file)

hosts.name: Name
hosts.enableDesc: Show this host in the Tmux Monitor and add its tmux actions to the sidebar.

apply.tmuxMissing: tmux is not installed on this host

hostEditor.title: Tmux Configuration
hostEditor.description: Options applied to tmux sessions on this host. Values left on their default follow the folder, user or server defaults.
hostEditor.exitEmpty: Close server when last session exits

use.title: Use Tmux Configuration
use.description: View hosts, edit their tmux options and apply configurations over SSH.

sessions.title: Drive tmux session creation
sessions.description: Let the terminal use this plugin's tmux.sessions service: sessions are created and attached with the configuration managed here.

defaultForNewHosts.label: Enable for new hosts
defaultForNewHosts.description: Pre-enable Tmux Configuration on hosts that do not have an explicit setting yet.

applyParallelism.label: Apply parallelism
applyParallelism.description: How many hosts are configured at the same time during a bulk apply.

enable.label: Enable Tmux Configuration
enable.description: Let this plugin manage the tmux options of this host.

historyLimit.label: History limit
historyLimit.description: history-limit: number of lines kept in each pane's scrollback.

mouse.label: Mouse
mouse.description: mouse: mouse support in tmux sessions.

renumberWindows.label: Renumber windows
renumberWindows.description: renumber-windows: renumber windows sequentially when one is closed.

setClipboard.label: Clipboard
setClipboard.description: set-clipboard: how tmux copies reach the system clipboard.

remainOnExit.label: Keep pane after command exits
remainOnExit.description: remain-on-exit: keep the pane visible when its command exits.

exitEmpty.label: Close server when last session exits
exitEmpty.description: exit-empty: shut the tmux server down when the last session is closed.

customOptions.label: Custom options
customOptions.description: Extra tmux options as a JSON object, e.g. {"default-shell": "/bin/zsh"}.

environment.label: Environment variables
environment.description: Variables set with set-environment -g as a JSON object.

configSnippet.label: Extra tmux commands
configSnippet.description: Raw tmux commands appended to the pushed config file (one per line).

sessionNamePattern.label: Session name pattern
sessionNamePattern.description: Names new tmux sessions on this host. Variables: {user} (Termix login), {sshUser}, {host}, {hostId}, {date}, {time}, {datetime}, {timestamp}, {uuid}, {random}. Empty keeps the terminal's default name.

integration.conflict: Tmux Monitor currently drives tmux session creation for the terminal (service conflict with {{plugin}}). Configuration is still applied to live sessions and on auto-apply; disable Tmux Monitor to have sessions created with this plugin's options.
integration.serviceInactive: Session creation does not follow this plugin's options right now (the terminal's tmux provider is unavailable or another plugin holds it). Configuration is still applied to live sessions and on auto-apply.
